# meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policy (Data Source)

This data source can read the `Organization Policies Global Group Policy` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policy" "example" {
  id              = "12345678"
  organization_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the policy
- `group_number` (Number) Group number used to track the policy across different networks and devices in the organization
- `name` (String) Name of the policy
